nodes.title: SawMaster 18"
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

Our SAWMASTER 18’’ Large Cutting machine from Rhino Lapidary is designed for cutting all kinds of materials such as gemstones, marble, ceramics, glass and granite in a fast, safe and standard way in the desired thickness. Thanks to the high technology and durable materials used in our machine, you can cut without any problems for years.

A key feature in this machine are patented longitudinal, anti-vibration, sealed bearings which provide a wiggle-free vice. This makes your cut less prone to breaking and extensive saw-marks, even at a thickness of 1.5mm.

Cutting speed is 8mm/min (1 inch in 3 minutes). In addition, with the Auto-Feed system, patented by Rhino Lapidary, when the saw gets tired or cannot cut for any reason, the vice advancement system automatically slows down and reduces the load of the saw. This extends the life of your saw. It prevents damages such as jamming and breaking caused by user errors. It also protects the motor by slowing down the cutting when necessary and prevents it from heating and burning.

In addition, the machine has an automatic stop feature in place for when the cutting is finished or if the cover is opened while it is working. All parts are CE and TSEK certified.

Fits up to 18" Saw

Blade not included

Electricity: 110V 60HZ

Cutting Height: 6 1/2"

Cutting Length: 9 7/8"

Cutting Speed: 7/8’’/min

Motor: 1.8KW 1700rpm with crossfeed

Machine Dimensions: 105cm width x 130cm length x 130cm height

Machine Weight: 287lbs

Blade not included

All parts are CE and TSEK certified

nodes.title: ShapeMaster 6"
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

With the new SHAPEMASTER from Rhino Lapidary, it's very easy and quick to make calibrated, exact shapes, even with little to no experience. Shaping a heart, oval, round, barrel, marquise, and many more are all possible just by gently turning the control wheel. You can also make shapes in larger or smaller sizes without changing the master shape.

29 trendy metal master shapes come included with the machine free.

The machine uses 6” diameter 1/2" wheels for 3D shapes and 1/4" wheels for cabs.

Electricity: 110V 60Hz

Motor: 0.55 kW monophase 3000 rpm

Cooling: circulating tap water

Wheels: 6” diameter, 1” hole diameter

1/2 R: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 mm

1/4 R: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 mm

Dimensions: 20” x 24” x 16”

Weight: 100 Lb.

Packed safely in a wooden pallet box

nodes.alt: Rhino Lapidary ShapeMaster machine, angled front view

nodes.title: Sled Release Handle
nodes.descriptionHtml: A metal clamp release mechanism used to adjust Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster's vice sled forwards and backwards.

nodes.title: Small Drill
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 0.75-millimeter diameter drill head on a 4.5-centimeter-long drill bit for both silversmithing and stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Small Silversmithing Ball Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 1.5-millimeter diameter ball head on a 4.5-centimeter-long drill bit for silversmithing. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Small Stonework Bullnose Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 1- to 2-millimeter diameter bullnose head on a 4.2-centimeter-long drill bit for stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Small Stonework Inverted 60° Cone Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 2.5- to 1-millimeter diameter inverted 60° cone head on a 4-centimeter-long drill bit for stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Spoke Wrench
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 0.25-inch diameter, 6.75-inch-long wrench to turn pieces with adjustment holes of the same size.

nodes.title: Spotlight
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 3.5-inch diameter light attached to a 38-inch-long jointed metal arm that fits into Rhino Lapidary's EM-1 and plugs into the EM-1's electric line. Uses the MR16 LED Bulb.

nodes.title: Stonework Ball Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 4-millimeter diameter ball head on a 4.2-centimeter-long drill bit for stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Stonework Flame Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 1/2- to 4-millimeter diameter flame head on a 4.3-centimeter-long drill bit for stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Stonework Inverted 30° Cone Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 3- to 2-millimeter diameter inverted 30° cone head on a 4.2-centimeter-long drill bit for stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Stonework Taper Head
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 1/4- to 4-millimeter diameter taper head on a 4.5-centimeter-long drill bit for stonework. Attaches to the Flexible Shaft.

nodes.title: Thumb Spindle Knob
nodes.descriptionHtml: A black knob on Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster's thumb spindle that is used to secure the horizontal movement of the vice sled.

nodes.title: TOFF Brush Wheel
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 0.75-inch-wide, 3-inch diameter, polishing brush wheel for silversmithing. Fits onto a Metal Spindle.

nodes.title: Triangle Latch Screws, x2
nodes.descriptionHtml: A set of two screws with triangular latch heads, used for hooking either side of the workspace cover of the TrimMaster to the reservoir frame, securing the workspace during machine operation.

nodes.title: Trim Saw Accessories Knob
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 1.5-inch diameter plastic knob with a 3-inch-long screw used for securing the Saw Table, Water Guard, and Plastic Trim Saw Spacer together.

nodes.title: TrimMaster
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

?Sawing slabs and stones for years in comfort is possible with the new TRIMMASTER trim saw!

You will never have a rusted cutting platform of your machine again, thanks to the Plexiglass surface that easily lifts away. The plexiglass has 4 drainage holes to keep water/oil in the lower reservoir, and adjustable feet let you ensure the tilt is correct for the drainage, even if you are not on a perfectly level surface.

The Trimmaster also comes with spacers for the plexiglass cover that allow you to raise it over the edge of the cutting platform for cutting larger material. There is also a removable, straight-edge guide included for consistent and accurate cutting.

Electricity: 110V 60Hz

Motor: Monophase, 0.37 kw, >3000 rpm

Cooling: self circulating water/oil

Cutting Length: 5"

Cutting Height: 2"

Dimensions: W14” x L22” x H14”

Weight: 50 Lb.

Packed safely in a wooden pallet box

Blade not included

compatible with 6” or 8” diameter, 1” hole diameter

nodes.alt: Rhino Lapidary TrimMaster machine, angled front view

nodes.title: TrimMaster Adjustable Feet, x4
nodes.descriptionHtml: This set of 4 feet are adjustable through the hex nut attached to their screws. These Adjustable feet screw onto the four corners of the bottom of the TrimMaster.

nodes.title: TrimMaster Belt Guard
nodes.descriptionHtml: A steel frame for protecting the motor belt and pulleys on the left side of the TrimMaster.

nodes.title: TrimMaster Plexiglass Insert
nodes.descriptionHtml: A blue plexiglass panel with a slit for the TrimMaster saw blade to fit through, and screw holes for securing and adjusting the plexiglass panel between its raised and lowered configurations.

nodes.title: TrimMaster Splash Guard, Front
nodes.descriptionHtml: COMING SOON

nodes.title: TrimMaster Splash Guard, Upper
nodes.descriptionHtml: A metal guard for controlling lubricant spray while operating the TrimMaster saw. This guard is secured behind the blade and hangs over the blade to catch any liquid flying vertically and maintaining blade lubricant. The guard can moved up or down to adjust the angle at which the guard hangs over the blade.

nodes.title: TrimMaster Straight Edge Guide
nodes.descriptionHtml: This device is mounted on the left side of the work area on the TrimMaster. The Straight Edge Guide provides an edge to rest slabs and other specimens on to ensure a straight cut while operating the TrimMaster.

nodes.title: Vice Clamp Riser
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 3" tall riser for holding specimens at a higher level while using Rhino Lapidary's JadeMaster. This allows you to make the most of the saw blade, letting the specimen pass over the arbor nut.

nodes.title: Vice Clamp Set
nodes.descriptionHtml: A set of two plates that affix specimens in place during Rhino Lapidary rock saw operation.

nodes.title: Water Guard
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 9x5x0.2-inch metal insert to protect users from water spray while using the 6" Trim Saw attachment.

nodes.title: Water Pump
nodes.descriptionHtml: A 5x2.75x1.75-inch water pump that pairs to Rhino Lapidary's patented water filtration system with a 6-foot-long cord.

nodes.title: Wing Nut, x2
nodes.descriptionHtml: A set of two wing nuts for securing vice clamps in Rhino Lapidary's rock saws.
